verdict.rationale: The evidence shows TruffleHog scanning many source types (git, chats, wikis, logs, object stores, filesystems, Docker images) and classifying over 800 secret types. Nothing documents coverage of programming languages or package ecosystems such as npm, PyPI or Maven, or states that scanning is language-agnostic. The Husky mention is only a pre-commit hook integration for JavaScript projects, an adjacent feature rather than language or ecosystem scan coverage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scan projects across all the major languages and package ecosystems my organization uses
